description: Shell script defining functions and environment variables for configuring a Kubernetes cluster on GCE, including node counts, disk sizes, IP ranges, and Windows node setup.

methods.name: get-num-nodes
methods.description: Returns the total number of Linux and Windows nodes in the cluster.

methods.name: get-master-size
methods.description: Suggests master node size based on total node count.

methods.name: get-master-root-disk-size
methods.description: Suggests master root disk size based on total node count.

methods.name: get-master-disk-size
methods.description: Suggests master disk size based on total node count.

methods.name: get-node-ip-range
methods.description: Determines the IP range for nodes based on total node count or environment variable.

methods.name: get-cluster-ip-range
methods.description: Determines the cluster IP range based on total node count.

methods.name: get-alias-range-size
methods.description: Calculates IP alias range size based on maximum number of pods.
